compat_notes: The build fetches fonts.google.com. package.json has no engines field (the research note said Node >=22.12; that comes from Astro 7's own requirement, not the repo). CI uses Node 20, but I used 24. The contact form is a plain HTML POST to config params.contact_form_action (default '#'), so it needs a separate form service. netlify.toml (build command and publish dir only) and wrangler.jsonc (404-page not_found_handling) are not applied on Wasmer. trailingSlash 'never' with directory output (about/index.html): check that Wasmer serves /about without a trailing slash. The README file is lowercase readme.md. No Staticfile needed: astro.config sets no outDir, so the build writes to Astro's default dist (verified in the build), which is the folder node_static serves. SWS 2.38.0 check (logs/zeon-studio_astroplate.sws-routes.log): /about-style links get one 308 to /about/ then 200; canonical (no-slash) vs served (slash) URL differ.
policy: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md contain only coding-agent guidance (read Astro docs, use the template skill); no contribution restrictions. No CONTRIBUTING or PR template; no zeon-studio/.github repo. Cloudflare deploy-config PR #86 was closed unmerged, but the maintainers later added wrangler.jsonc and the README Cloudflare section themselves, so this is not a refusal of host docs. The README already documents Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, Docker and Sitepins. No existing Wasmer PR or issue.
why: The README Getting Started section has per-host deploy subsections (Cloudflare Workers, Docker) and netlify.toml publishes the static dist folder; a matching Wasmer subsection fits.
